appScript:
#filePath=1_Setup\DemoApp.msi;appName=DemoApp
SET_PATH 'Program Files\DemoApp'
PRINT 正在安装 DemoApp ...
RUN_INFO 'msiexec.exe' '/i "%RUN_PATH%\1_Setup\DemoApp.msi" INSTALLDIR="%PATH%" /qb /norestart /L*V "%TEMP%install_demoapp.log"'
SLEEP 3000
PRINT DemoApp 安装完成

#filePath=1_Setup\Setup.exe;appName=DemoApp
# 向导型安装包：抓到的控件 ID 填在 CLICK / SET_TEXT 里（见 tools/WinSnap）
SET_PATH 'Program Files\DemoApp'
PRINT 开始安装 DemoApp ...
RUN_A 'start "" "%RUN_PATH%\1_Setup\Setup.exe"'
WHILE_WIN '安装 - DemoApp' 60
SET_WIN '安装 - DemoApp'
CLICK_TEXT 我接受
SLEEP 1500
CLICK_TEXT 下一步
WHILE_WIN '选择文件夹' 30
SET_TEXT 4 PATH
CLICK 1
SLEEP 1500
SET_WIN '安装 - DemoApp'
CLICK_TEXT 安装
WHILE_TEXT 完成 200
CLICK_TEXT 完成
SLEEP 2000
PRINT DemoApp 安装完成
